SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM oms_order WHERE delete_status = 0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order WHERE delete_status = 0 AND `status` = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_home_advertise WHERE status = 1 AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN delete_status = 0 AND publish_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offShelfCount, SUM(CASE WHEN delete_status = 0 AND publish_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onShelfCount, SUM(CASE WHEN delete_status = 0 AND COALESCE(low_stock, 0) > 0 AND stock <= low_stock THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowStockCount, SUM(CASE WHEN delete_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS productCount FROM pms_product

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{todayStart} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{todayStart}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memberTodayAdd, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND create_time < #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memberYesterdayAdd, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memberMonthAdd, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM ums_member

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS orderAmount FROM oms_order WHERE delete_status = 0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
